title: Indicator formula for a three-sign equation
statement: For a sign $b$ and three signs $y_0,y_1,y_2$, the indicator that $y_0y_1y_2=b$ equals $\bigl(1+b\,y_0y_1y_2\bigr)/2$, identifying each sign with its real value.
hypotheses_covered: A triple of signs indexed by 0, 1, and 2
